# Code of Conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant v2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

By participating, you agree to uphold this code. Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/ferrumclaudepilgrim/claude-code-android/security/advisories/new) -- same channel used for security reports. Use a clear subject like "Code of Conduct report" so the maintainer can route it correctly.

Do not open a public issue for Code of Conduct concerns.
